verdict.rationale: Core operations (token creation/charge/introspect, service creation, KYA verification) are all documented as REST API endpoints, and an MCP server exposes agentic workflows, showing strong API-first parity with the UI dashboard/playground. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s on all candidate paths), and some UI-only flows like account approval, dashboard-based key management, and paid KYA subscription setup aren't confirmed as fully API-driven. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/swagger spec, confirmation that account/service approval and subscription management can be done purely via API without dashboard interaction, independent third-party confirmation of full API/UI parity.
